title: Trilateral Commission cross-network and biography-freshness pass, 2026-08-08
summary: Depth-2 audit of selected current roster entries against authoritative employer, governance, and public-office sources, focused on cross-network bridges and independent membership-versus-biography freshness.

sources.title: Chevron Completes Acquisition of Hess Corporation
John B. Hess joins Chevron's Board of Directors
Peter Harder - Senate committee evidence, May 5 2026

evidence.observation: Laurence D. Fink is on the current Trilateral roster, while the World Economic Forum currently identifies Larry Fink as a co-chair and Board of Trustees member.
Jared Cohen is on the current Trilateral roster, while Goldman Sachs explicitly lists his Trilateral, CFR, and CNAS affiliations.
The Trilateral roster still describes John B. Hess as CEO of Hess Corporation, while Chevron completed its Hess acquisition in July 2025 and subsequently appointed John Hess to Chevron's board.
The Trilateral roster describes Marek Belka as a Member of the European Parliament, while the European Parliament records his ninth-term service ending on 2024-07-15.
Peter Harder's Canadian Senate title is independently current in 2026, so the Commission's rotate-off language cannot safely be encoded as a blanket public-office exclusion rule.

gaps: Cross-dataset aliases are not normalized across all packets.
Current biography fields need independent role-source freshness.
caveats: Cross-network affiliation does not establish control, coordination, wrongdoing, or shared views.
Current roster inclusion and current biography text are separate claims.

workflow.next_action: Resolve current-roster identities to existing canonical dossiers and separate membership-status timestamps from role/employer freshness timestamps.

notes: Roster-membership freshness and biography-role freshness are separate dimensions.
Resolve Laurence D. Fink to the existing Larry Fink dossier before duplicate creation.
Jared Cohen is an explicit multi-organization bridge in a current Goldman Sachs bio.
The rotate-off policy needs source-qualified interpretation.

classification_rules: Track Commission roster status independently from biography/employer-role freshness.
Use authoritative employer, regulator, legislature, or officeholder sources for current role text.
Resolve exact identities before creating cross-dataset recurrence edges.
Treat cross-membership as affiliation only, not evidence of coordination or misconduct.
Do not turn rotate-off language into a blanket public-office exclusion without source-defined scope.
data.method: Checked selected high-signal current Trilateral roster entries against authoritative employer, governance, and public-office sources and compared them with queued cross-tie targets.
data.narrative_role: cross-network bridge discovery, field freshness audit, and skeptic pass
data.research_question: Which high-confidence cross-network relations can be resolved from current roster entries, and which biography fields are stale enough to require separate freshness semantics?

findings.finding: Membership-status freshness and biography-role freshness are independent dimensions.
Laurence D. Fink is a high-confidence Trilateral-to-WEF bridge.
Jared Cohen is a high-confidence Trilateral-to-Goldman/CFR/CNAS bridge.
Current-roster role text contains confirmed stale fields.
The rotate-off language cannot safely be encoded as a blanket public-office exclusion rule.
